title: Index: Core Loop
summary: Search, compare, tag, and follow records until a decision becomes obvious.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Find an item or recipe, inspect its category, read linked entries, then follow source facts or relations until you have a route or crafting plan.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each lookup, decide whether the record changed a route, recipe, objective, or upgrade choice. If it did not, narrow the search.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop browsing when you have the next action. Pin the useful record and return to play before research becomes delay.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
